worked_trace.heading: Worked lowering: “publish the summary, expose no private paths”
worked_trace.maximum_inference: Stable obligation identity and repair closure can be represented; natural semantic compilation, arbitrary equivalence, compiler correctness, and evaluator competence remain unproven.

counterexample_or_simpler_baseline: The syntax-only compiler accepts valid HTML. The semantic compiler checks the target against both required output and preserved non-goals.
readable_claim: Compilation succeeds only when every obligation and non-goal survives lowering into the actual target artifact; syntactic validity is not semantic preservation.
normative_rule: Give each obligation a stable semantic identity, bind every compiler pass and declared loss, validate the produced target independently, and compute dependency closure after repair. Missing atoms, authority escape, cyclic dependencies, failed validators, or lost obligations block lowering.
